snippet.title: "KARATE ROGUE" GamePlay PV　―A Roguelike Martial Arts Dungeon RPG
snippet.description:
A fusion of martial arts and roguelike dungeon crawling—build your fighter, master lethal techniques, and conquer the abyss with your fists alone. Strike. Survive. Evolve.

武術の技でダンジョンに挑め！

人気コミック「空手バカ異世界」原作者が開発を手掛ける、ローグライク・格闘・ダンジョンクローラーRPG「KARATE ROGUE」のゲームプレイを紹介。
ビジュアルや演出も強化中！

●Steam wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/36...

●presented by 輝井堂GAMES
